name: R&B Denims Ltd
about: Incorporated in 2010, R&B Denims Ltd manufactures and sells quality Denim Textile products[1]
keyPoints:
Business Profile[1]
R & B Denims Ltd., established in 2012 through a collaboration between the RawatKhedia and Borana groups, is a prominent textile manufacturer based in Surat, India. Both founding groups have over 30 years of experience in the textile industry, with the Borana group producing over 1.5 million meters of polyester grey fabrics monthly and the RawatKhedia group processing over 5 million meters of premium synthetic fabrics per month.
Product Portfolio[2]
a) Fabric Range:
100% Cotton, Blends, Cotton -Tencel, Organic Cotton, Power Stretch, Cotton Elastane, Metallic Coating (Shiny), Yarn Dyed Multiple, Coloured Weft, Cotton/Poly/Elastane
b) Specialized Yarns:
Cotton Tencel, Organic Yarns
c) Weaves:
Plain, Rib Stop, Oxford, Matty, Twill, Satin, Dobby, Knitted Dobby, Herring bone, Honey Comb, Broken Twill
d) Shades:
IBST, SBIT, Dark Indigo, Multi-coloured shades
e) Finishes:
Soft finishes, Sanforizing, Desized Silky feel, Mercerized, Coated fabric, Various Chemical & Mechanical finish.
f) Rico:
High quality carded & combed auto coned grey cotton yarns

cons: Though the company is reporting repeated profits, it is not paying out dividend
The company has delivered a poor sales growth of 7.38% over past five years.
Earnings include an other income of Rs.21.8 Cr.
Promoter holding has decreased over last 3 years: -16.4%
